## Details

<a id="cell_offset_keys"></a>
### [`cell_offset_keys`](../../../../src/screen/cell_screen_tables.asm#L6) `$53B0`

*data*

14 entries of 3 bytes: a Y offset in the cave map ($29 = current cell), then the matching screen buffer offset (low, high).

- **Read by:** [`cell_draw_address`](../engine/cell_draw.md#cell_draw_address)

<a id="cell_offset_lo"></a>
### [`cell_offset_lo`](../../../../src/screen/cell_screen_tables.asm#L8) `$53B1`

*data*

Low byte of the buffer offset. One cell is 2 characters wide, one cell row is 160 bytes.

- **Read by:** [`cell_draw_address`](../engine/cell_draw.md#cell_draw_address)

<a id="cell_offset_hi"></a>
### [`cell_offset_hi`](../../../../src/screen/cell_screen_tables.asm#L10) `$53B2-$53D9`

*data*

High byte of the buffer offset.

- **Read by:** [`cell_draw_address`](../engine/cell_draw.md#cell_draw_address)

<a id="cave_row_addr_lo"></a>
### [`cave_row_addr_lo`](../../../../src/screen/cell_screen_tables.asm#L26) `$53DA`

*data*

22 words, one for each cave row: the address of column 0 in the screen buffer, $4003 plus 160 times the row.

- **Read by:** [`set_cell`](../engine/cell_draw.md#set_cell), [`draw_current_as_steel`](../engine/stages.md#draw_current_as_steel), [`cover_map_buffer`](cover.md#cover_map_buffer)
